criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Build suitable regressors from calendar, lag and rolling features derived only from past observations.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Use chronological or rolling validation; avoid random shuffling and keep the final future holdout untouched.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare models and simple baselines on the same horizon using MAE/RMSE/sMAPE and relevant group breakdowns.

criteria.name: Feature Importance & Residual Analysis
criteria.guidance: Inspect feature importance, residual patterns and forecast bias by time/store/item without unsupported causal explanations.

criteria.name: Forecast Segmentation & Business Interpretation
criteria.guidance: Analyze forecast quality across store/item segments and explain operational implications based on measured evidence.
